name: chatoffice
description: AI-native office suite (docs, sheets, slides, pdf)

scripts.build:all: npm run build -w @chaoffice/docs && npm run build -w @chaoffice/sheets && npm run build -w @chaoffice/slides && npm run build -w @chaoffice/pdf && npm run build -w @chaoffice/markdown && npm run build -w @chaoffice/html && npm run build -w @chaoffice/cli && npm run build -w @chaoffice/shell
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n docs,sheets,slides,pdf,markdown,html,shell -c blue,green,yellow,red,cyan,white,magenta "npm run dev:renderer -w @chaoffice/docs" "npm run dev:renderer -w @chaoffice/sheets" "npm run dev:renderer -w @chaoffice/slides" "npm run dev:renderer -w @chaoffice/pdf" "npm run dev:renderer -w @chaoffice/markdown" "npm run dev:renderer -w @chaoffice/html" "node scripts/dev-shell.mjs"
scripts.dist:linux: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run dist:linux -w @chaoffice/shell
scripts.dist:mac: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run native:build:universal -w @chaoffice/sheets && npm run dist:mac -w @chaoffice/shell
scripts.dist:server: npm run notices && docker build -f apps/server/Dockerfile -t chatoffice-server:latest .
scripts.dist:win: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run dist:win -w @chaoffice/shell
scripts.shell: node tools/patch-dev-electron-name.mjs && npm run build:all && electron apps/shell
scripts.test: npm run test -w @chaoffice/i18n && npm run test -w @chaoffice/electron-utils && npm run test -w @chaoffice/font-metrics && npm run test -w @chaoffice/zip-gate && npm run test -w @chaoffice/odf2ooxml && npm run test -w @chaoffice/docx-engine && npm run test -w @chaoffice/pdf2docx && npm run test -w @chaoffice/html2docx && npm run test -w @chaoffice/ppt2pptx && npm run test -w @chaoffice/compound-file && npm run test -w @chaoffice/doc2docx && npm run test -w @chaoffice/hwp2docx && npm run test -w @chaoffice/file-parse && npm run test -w @chaoffice/pipelines && npm run test -w @chaoffice/pptx-engine && npm run test -w @chaoffice/xlsx-gateway && npm run test -w @chaoffice/pptx-ops && npm run test -w @chaoffice/pptx-render && npm run test -w @chaoffice/chart-kit && npm run test -w @chaoffice/ai-search && npm run test -w @chaoffice/agent-core && npm run test -w @chaoffice/ai-provider && npm run test -w @chaoffice/storage-adapter && npm run test -w @chaoffice/service-core && npm run test -w @chaoffice/project-store && npm run test -w @chaoffice/cli && npm run test -w @chaoffice/ui && npm run test -w @chaoffice/ribbon && npm run test -w @chaoffice/mobile-touch && npm run test -w @chaoffice/docs && npm run test -w @chaoffice/sheets && npm run test -w @chaoffice/shell && npm run test -w @chaoffice/slides && npm run test -w @chaoffice/pdf && npm run test -w @chaoffice/markdown && npm run test -w @chaoffice/web-bridge && npm run test -w @chaoffice/server && npm run test -w @chaoffice/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @chaoffice/i18n && npm run typecheck -w @chaoffice/electron-utils && npm run typecheck -w @chaoffice/font-metrics && npm run typecheck -w @chaoffice/zip-gate && npm run typecheck -w @chaoffice/odf2ooxml && npm run typecheck -w @chaoffice/docx-engine && npm run typecheck -w @chaoffice/pdf2docx && npm run typecheck -w @chaoffice/html2docx && npm run typecheck -w @chaoffice/ppt2pptx && npm run typecheck -w @chaoffice/compound-file && npm run typecheck -w @chaoffice/doc2docx && npm run typecheck -w @chaoffice/hwp2docx && npm run typecheck -w @chaoffice/file-parse && npm run typecheck -w @chaoffice/xlsx-gateway && npm run typecheck -w @chaoffice/pptx-ops && npm run typecheck -w @chaoffice/pipelines && npm run typecheck -w @chaoffice/pptx-engine && npm run typecheck -w @chaoffice/pptx-render && npm run typecheck -w @chaoffice/chart-kit && npm run typecheck -w @chaoffice/ai-search && npm run typecheck -w @chaoffice/agent-core && npm run typecheck -w @chaoffice/ai-provider && npm run typecheck -w @chaoffice/storage-adapter && npm run typecheck -w @chaoffice/service-core && npm run typecheck -w @chaoffice/project-store && npm run typecheck -w @chaoffice/cli && npm run typecheck -w @chaoffice/ui && npm run typecheck -w @chaoffice/ribbon && npm run typecheck -w @chaoffice/mobile-touch && npm run typecheck -w @chaoffice/docs && npm run typecheck -w @chaoffice/sheets && npm run typecheck -w @chaoffice/shell && npm run typecheck -w @chaoffice/slides && npm run typecheck -w @chaoffice/pdf && npm run typecheck -w @chaoffice/markdown && npm run typecheck -w @chaoffice/web-bridge && npm run typecheck -w @chaoffice/server && npm run typecheck -w @chaoffice/web
